headline: JSA advises Ixigo on majority stake acquisition in Brevistay
sum: Le Travenues Technology Limited, dba Ixigo, has acquired a 54.66% majority stake in Brevistay Hospitality Private Limited. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised Ixigo on this acquisition.
detail: Le Travenues Technology Limited, dba Ixigo, has acquired a 54.66% majority stake in Brevistay Hospitality Private Limited. JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised Ixigo on this acquisition. The Firm provided end-to-end support in relation to transaction including conducting legal due diligence on Brevistay, negotiating and finalizing the transaction documents and providing assistance with pre-closing actions. The transaction team consisted of Archana Tewary (Partner), Savio Tom (Principal Associate), Nandini Menon (Senior Associate), Naveen Kumar (Associate) and Sanchari Sengupta (Junior Associate).
